title: DuoMI: Dual Mutual Information Regularization for Expert Reuse in Looped Transformers
abstract: arXiv:2611.33952v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: We introduce Dual Mutual Information Regularization (DuoMI), a method for regulating expert routing across rounds in looped mixture-of-experts (MoE) Transformers. When two rounds of computation share an expert pool, their routers may favor different expert subsets, limiting the reuse of individual expert parameters across rounds. Even when aggregate expert usage is identical across rounds, we would still prefer each token to retain some experts while switching to others. DuoMI addresses both aspects of routing: it uses round-level marginal mutual information to limit the dependence of aggregate expert usage on the round, and token-level conditional mutual information to penalize average cross-round routing changes that fall outside a target interval. During training, DuoMI computes differentiable penalties from soft routing distributions over all experts. It adds no model parameters and leaves sparse Top-$k$ routing strategy unchanged

translated_title: DuoMI：用于循环Transformer中专家重用的双互信息正则化
translated_abstract: 我们提出了双互信息正则化（DuoMI），这是一种用于调节循环混合专家Transformer中跨轮次专家路由的方法。当两轮计算共享一个专家池时，它们的路由器可能偏好不同的专家子集，从而限制了单个专家参数在轮次间的重用。即使各轮次的总体专家使用情况相同，我们仍然希望每个token在保留部分专家的同时切换到其他专家。DuoMI同时处理路由的两个方面：它使用轮次级边缘互信息来限制总体专家使用对轮次的依赖，并使用token级条件互信息来惩罚超出目标区间的平均跨轮路由变化。在训练过程中，DuoMI从所有专家的软路由分布中计算可微分的惩罚项。它不增加任何模型参数，并保持稀疏Top-k路由策略不变。
tldr: DuoMI通过轮次级边缘互信息和token级条件互信息的双重正则化，在不增加参数和改变稀疏Top-k路由的前提下，调节循环MoE Transformer中跨轮次的专家路由以实现专家参数的高效重用。
en_tdlr: DuoMI employs dual mutual information regularization—round-level marginal MI and token-level conditional MI—to regulate expert routing across rounds in looped MoE Transformers for expert reuse, without adding parameters or altering sparse Top-k routing.
